question_vi: Tổng số đơn hàng là bao nhiêu?
question_en: How many orders are there?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn đã được giao?
question_en: How many orders have been delivered?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

question_vi: Những năm nào có đơn hàng?
question_en: Which years have orders?
reference_sql: SELECT YEAR(order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY year

question_vi: Top 5 danh mục có nhiều sản phẩm được bán nhất?
question_en: What are the top 5 product categories by number of items sold?
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name AS category, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question_vi: Giá trị thanh toán của các đơn đã giao theo năm?
question_en: What is the total payment value of delivered orders by purchase year?
reference_sql: SELECT YEAR(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment FROM orders o JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY year

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu khách hàng đã mua lại?
question_en: How many customers made more than one purchase?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1) AS repeat_customer_ids

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu khách hàng duy nhất đã mua hàng?
question_en: How many unique customers have purchased?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng được giao trễ?
question_en: How many orders were delivered late?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS late_deliveries FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu bản ghi khách hàng?
question_en: How many customer records are there?

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu người bán trong dữ liệu?

question_en: How many order-item rows are there?

question_en: Which order statuses occur in the data?

question_en: Show the first 10 sellers with their city and state.

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu bản ghi vị trí địa lý?
question_en: How many geolocation records are there?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_geolocation_records FROM geolocation

question_en: How many products have a photo-count value?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_with_photo_count FROM products WHERE product_photos_qty IS NOT NULL

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn được đặt trong năm 2016?
question_en: How many orders were placed in 2016?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_2016 FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-01-01'

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn được đặt trong tháng 12 năm 2017?
question_en: How many orders were placed in December 2017?

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn được đặt trong tháng 3 năm 2018?
question_en: How many orders were placed in March 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_march_2018 FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-03-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn được đặt trước năm 2017?
question_en: How many orders were placed before 2017?

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn được đặt trong quý I năm 2018?
question_en: How many orders were placed in the first quarter of 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_q1_2018 FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn đã giao được phê duyệt trong năm 2018?
question_en: How many delivered orders were approved in 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders_approved_2018 FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_approved_at >= '2018-01-01' AND order_approved_at < '2019-01-01'

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn đã giao đến khách hàng trong năm 2018?
question_en: How many orders were delivered to customers in 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_deliveries_2018 FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date >= '2018-01-01' AND order_delivered_customer_date < '2019-01-01'

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn có ngày giao dự kiến trong tháng 3 năm 2018?
question_en: How many orders had an estimated delivery date in March 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_estimated_march_2018 FROM orders WHERE order_estimated_delivery_date >= '2018-03-01' AND order_estimated_delivery_date < '2018-04-01'

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn được đặt trong tháng 8 năm 2018?
question_en: How many orders were placed in August 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_august_2018 FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-08-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn được đặt vào ngày 1 tháng 1 năm 2018?
question_en: How many orders were placed on January 1, 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_on_2018_01_01 FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-02'

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn chưa được phê duyệt?
question_en: How many orders have not been approved?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unapproved_orders FROM orders WHERE order_approved_at IS NULL

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn giao trễ được đặt trong năm 2018?
question_en: How many late-delivered orders were placed in 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_deliveries_2018 FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn có thời điểm phê duyệt sớm hơn thời điểm đặt?
question_en: How many orders have an approval timestamp earlier than the purchase timestamp?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS approval_before_purchase_orders FROM orders WHERE order_approved_at IS NOT NULL AND order_approved_at < order_purchase_timestamp

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn đã giao đến khách trong vòng 7 ngày kể từ khi đặt?
question_en: How many delivered orders reached the customer within 7 days of purchase?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS deliveries_within_7_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date <= order_purchase_timestamp + INTERVAL 7 DAY

question_vi: Hiển thị 10 đơn đã giao đầu tiên sau ngày 1 tháng 10 năm 2018.
question_en: Show the first 10 delivered orders after October 1, 2018.
reference_sql: SELECT order_id, order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date >= '2018-10-01' ORDER BY order_delivered_customer_date LIMIT 10

question_vi: Hiển thị 10 đơn hàng cùng thành phố và bang của khách hàng.
question_en: Show 10 orders with the customer's city and state.
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_city, c.customer_state FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp LIMIT 10

question_vi: Đếm số đơn hàng theo bang của khách hàng.
question_en: Count orders by customer state.
reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_state AS customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_orders DESC

question_vi: Hiển thị 10 dòng hàng cùng danh mục sản phẩm.
question_en: Show 10 order-item rows with their product category.
reference_sql: SELECT oi.order_id, oi.order_item_id, p.product_category_name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY oi.order_id, oi.order_item_id LIMIT 10

question_vi: Top 5 bang của người bán theo số dòng hàng đã bán là gì?
question_en: What are the top 5 seller states by number of order-item rows sold?
reference_sql: SELECT s.seller_state AS seller_state, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng có ít nhất một đánh giá?
question_en: How many orders have at least one review?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_with_reviews FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id

question_vi: Điểm đánh giá trung bình theo trạng thái đơn hàng là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the average review score by order status?
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_status AS order_status, AVG(r.review_score) AS average_review_score FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY average_review_score DESC

question_vi: Hiển thị 10 bản ghi thanh toán cùng trạng thái đơn hàng.
question_en: Show 10 payment records with their order status.
reference_sql: SELECT op.order_id, op.payment_type, op.payment_value, o.order_status FROM order_payments op JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY op.order_id, op.payment_sequential LIMIT 10

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu sản phẩm có bản dịch danh mục tiếng Anh?
question_en: How many products have an English category translation?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS products_with_english_category FROM products p JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name

question_vi: Top 10 cặp bang khách hàng và bang người bán theo số dòng hàng là gì?
question_en: What are the top 10 customer-state and seller-state pairs by order-item rows?
reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_state AS customer_state, s.seller_state AS seller_state, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY c.customer_state, s.seller_state ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 10

question_vi: Top 5 thành phố khách hàng theo số đơn đã giao là gì?
question_en: What are the top 5 customer cities by delivered-order count?
reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_city AS customer_city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC LIMIT 5

question_vi: Hiển thị 10 đơn đã giao kèm điểm đánh giá.
question_en: Show 10 delivered orders with their review score.
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_delivered_customer_date, r.review_score FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' ORDER BY o.order_delivered_customer_date LIMIT 10

question_vi: Đếm số bản ghi thanh toán của đơn đã giao theo phương thức thanh toán.
question_en: Count payment records for delivered orders by payment type.
reference_sql: SELECT op.payment_type AS payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_records FROM orders o JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY op.payment_type ORDER BY payment_records DESC

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu dòng hàng có sản phẩm không có bản dịch danh mục tiếng Anh?
question_en: How many order-item rows belong to products without an English category translation?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_rows_without_english_category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name WHERE ct.product_category_name IS NULL

question_vi: Top 5 danh mục tiếng Anh theo số dòng hàng đã bán là gì?
question_en: What are the top 5 English categories by order-item rows sold?
reference_sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng có ít nhất một người bán ở bang SP?
question_en: How many orders involve at least one seller in state SP?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders_with_sp_seller FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.seller_state = 'SP'

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng có thể ghép với bản ghi khách hàng?
question_en: How many orders can be matched to a customer record?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_with_customer_record FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng có ít nhất một bản ghi thanh toán?
question_en: How many orders have at least one payment record?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_with_payment FROM orders o JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id

question_vi: Hiển thị 10 đánh giá cùng bang của người mua.
question_en: Show 10 reviews with the purchaser's state.
reference_sql: SELECT r.review_id, r.order_id, r.review_score, c.customer_state FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY r.review_creation_date LIMIT 10

question_vi: Giá trị trung bình của một bản ghi thanh toán là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the average value of a payment record?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(payment_value) AS average_payment_value FROM order_payments

question_vi: Tổng phí vận chuyển trên tất cả dòng hàng là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the total freight value across all order-item rows?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight_value FROM order_items

question_vi: Trung bình một đơn có bao nhiêu dòng hàng?
question_en: On average, how many order-item rows does an order have?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(item_count) AS average_items_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) AS item_counts

question_vi: Số đơn theo từng trạng thái là bao nhiêu?
question_en: How many orders are there for each status?
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY total_orders DESC

question_vi: Tổng giá trị thanh toán theo phương thức thanh toán là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the total payment value by payment type?
reference_sql: SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total_payment DESC

question_vi: Phân bố số bản ghi đánh giá theo điểm là gì?
question_en: What is the distribution of review records by score?
reference_sql: SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_records FROM order_reviews GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score

question_vi: Top 10 bang theo số bản ghi khách hàng là gì?
question_en: What are the top 10 states by customer-record count?
reference_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS customer_records FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_records DESC LIMIT 10

question_vi: Top 10 người bán theo tổng giá niêm yết của dòng hàng là ai?
question_en: Who are the top 10 sellers by total listed item price?
reference_sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS total_item_price FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_item_price DESC LIMIT 10

question_vi: Top 5 danh mục theo giá dòng hàng trung bình là gì?
question_en: What are the top 5 categories by average order-item price?
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name AS category, AVG(oi.price) AS average_item_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY average_item_price DESC LIMIT 5

question_vi: Giá trị thanh toán nhỏ nhất và lớn nhất là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What are the smallest and largest payment values?
reference_sql: SELECT MIN(payment_value) AS minimum_payment_value, MAX(payment_value) AS maximum_payment_value FROM order_payments

question_vi: Điểm đánh giá trung bình trên toàn bộ bản ghi đánh giá là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the overall average review score?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(review_score) AS average_review_score FROM order_reviews

question_vi: Số đơn theo năm đặt hàng là bao nhiêu?
question_en: How many orders were placed in each purchase year?
reference_sql: SELECT YEAR(order_purchase_timestamp) AS purchase_year, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY purchase_year

question_vi: Tổng giá trị thanh toán theo số kỳ thanh toán là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the total payment value by number of installments?
reference_sql: SELECT payment_installments, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_installments ORDER BY payment_installments

question_vi: Phí vận chuyển trung bình theo danh mục sản phẩm là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the average freight value by product category?
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name AS category, AVG(oi.freight_value) AS average_freight_value FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY average_freight_value DESC

question_vi: Số người bán theo bang là bao nhiêu?
question_en: How many sellers are there in each state?
reference_sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS total_sellers FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY total_sellers DESC

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu sản phẩm khác nhau xuất hiện trong dòng hàng?
question_en: How many distinct products appear in order-item rows?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_products_sold FROM order_items

question_vi: Tổng giá hàng và tổng phí vận chuyển trên các dòng hàng là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What are the total item price and total freight value across order-item rows?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(price) AS total_item_price, SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight_value FROM order_items

question_vi: Thời gian giao hàng trung bình từ lúc đặt đến lúc khách nhận là bao nhiêu ngày?
question_en: What is the average number of days from purchase to customer delivery?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS average_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question_vi: Giá trị thanh toán trung bình trên mỗi đơn có thanh toán là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the average total payment per order with payments?
reference_sql: WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT AVG(total_payment) AS average_payment_per_order FROM payment_by_order

question_vi: Tỷ lệ đơn đã giao bị trễ là bao nhiêu phần trăm?
question_en: What percentage of delivered orders were late?
reference_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS late_delivery_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL

question_vi: Tỷ lệ khách mua lại trong số khách đã mua là bao nhiêu phần trăm?
question_en: What percentage of purchasing customers are repeat customers?
reference_sql: WITH customer_order_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS repeat_customer_rate_pct FROM customer_order_counts

question_vi: Hiển thị 10 đơn đã giao có tổng thanh toán cao nhất cùng số dòng hàng.
question_en: Show the top 10 delivered orders by total payment with their item counts.
reference_sql: WITH item_counts AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id), payment_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.order_id, item_counts.item_count, payment_totals.total_payment FROM orders o JOIN item_counts ON o.order_id = item_counts.order_id JOIN payment_totals ON o.order_id = payment_totals.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' ORDER BY payment_totals.total_payment DESC LIMIT 10

question_vi: Số ngày trễ trung bình của các đơn giao trễ là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the average number of days late among late deliveries?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('day', order_estimated_delivery_date, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS average_days_late FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

question_vi: Phân bố đơn đã giao theo đúng/sớm và trễ là gì?
question_en: What is the distribution of delivered orders by on-or-early versus late delivery?
reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_or_early' END AS delivery_performance, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY delivery_performance ORDER BY delivery_performance

question_vi: Top 10 người bán theo số đơn đã giao có chứa hàng của họ là ai?
question_en: Who are the top 10 sellers by distinct delivered orders containing their items?
reference_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC LIMIT 10

question_vi: Tỷ lệ đơn đã giao có ít nhất một đánh giá là bao nhiêu phần trăm?
question_en: What percentage of delivered orders have at least one review?
reference_sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS reviewed_delivered_order_rate_pct FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

question_vi: Điểm đánh giá trung bình của đơn giao trễ so với đúng/sớm là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the average review score for late versus on-or-early delivered orders?
reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_or_early' END AS delivery_performance, AVG(r.review_score) AS average_review_score FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY delivery_performance ORDER BY delivery_performance

question_vi: Top 10 khách mua lại theo số đơn hàng là ai?
question_en: Who are the top 10 repeat customers by number of orders?
reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10

question_vi: Top 10 khách hàng theo tổng giá trị thanh toán của đơn đã giao là ai?
question_en: Who are the top 10 customers by total payment value of delivered orders?
reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY total_payment DESC LIMIT 10

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn có tổng thanh toán cao hơn mức trung bình theo đơn?
question_en: How many orders have a total payment above the per-order average?
reference_sql: WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_above_average_payment FROM payment_by_order WHERE total_payment > (SELECT AVG(total_payment) FROM payment_by_order)

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn có tổng thanh toán lớn hơn tổng giá hàng cộng phí vận chuyển?
question_en: How many orders have total payment greater than total item price plus freight?
reference_sql: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS item_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id), payment_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_payment_above_item_total FROM item_totals JOIN payment_totals ON item_totals.order_id = payment_totals.order_id WHERE payment_totals.total_payment > item_totals.item_total

question_vi: Số dòng hàng trung bình của đơn giao trễ so với đúng/sớm là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the average item count for late versus on-or-early delivered orders?
reference_sql: WITH item_counts AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_or_early' END AS delivery_performance, AVG(item_counts.item_count) AS average_item_count FROM orders o JOIN item_counts ON o.order_id = item_counts.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY delivery_performance ORDER BY delivery_performance

question_vi: Giá trị thanh toán tổng trung bình của khách mua lại so với khách mua một lần là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the average total payment for repeat versus one-time purchasing customers?
reference_sql: WITH customer_metrics AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 'repeat' ELSE 'one_time' END AS customer_segment, AVG(total_payment) AS average_total_payment FROM customer_metrics GROUP BY customer_segment ORDER BY customer_segment

question_vi: 5 bang khách hàng có điểm đánh giá trung bình thấp nhất là gì?
question_en: Which 5 customer states have the lowest average review score?
reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(r.review_score) AS average_review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_records FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_review_score ASC LIMIT 5

question_vi: Trung bình mất bao nhiêu ngày từ phê duyệt đến hãng vận chuyển và từ hãng vận chuyển đến khách?
question_en: What are the average days from approval to carrier and from carrier to customer?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('day', order_approved_at, order_delivered_carrier_date)) AS average_approval_to_carrier_days, AVG(DATEDIFF('day', order_delivered_carrier_date, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS average_carrier_to_customer_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_approved_at IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question_vi: Phương thức thanh toán nào có tổng thanh toán trung bình trên mỗi đơn cao nhất?
question_en: Which payment type has the highest average total payment per order?
reference_sql: WITH payment_by_type_order AS (SELECT payment_type, order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type, order_id) SELECT payment_type, AVG(total_payment) AS average_payment_per_order FROM payment_by_type_order GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY average_payment_per_order DESC

question_vi: Số khách mua lại theo bang là bao nhiêu?
question_en: How many repeat customers are there in each state?
reference_sql: WITH customer_order_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state) SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM customer_order_counts WHERE order_count > 1 GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY repeat_customers DESC

question_vi: Tỷ lệ giao trễ theo năm đặt hàng là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the late-delivery rate by purchase year?
reference_sql: SELECT YEAR(order_purchase_timestamp) AS purchase_year, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS late_delivery_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY YEAR(order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY purchase_year

question_vi: Hiển thị 10 đơn có nhiều bản ghi thanh toán nhất cùng tổng thanh toán.
question_en: Show the 10 orders with the most payment records and their total payment.
reference_sql: WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_record_count, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT order_id, payment_record_count, total_payment FROM payment_by_order WHERE payment_record_count > 1 ORDER BY payment_record_count DESC, total_payment DESC LIMIT 10

question_vi: Số khách mua lại trong cùng một năm đặt hàng là bao nhiêu theo năm?
question_en: How many customers made repeat purchases within the same purchase year, by year?
reference_sql: WITH customer_year_orders AS (SELECT YEAR(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS purchase_year, c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_purchase_timestamp), c.customer_unique_id) SELECT purchase_year, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM customer_year_orders WHERE order_count > 1 GROUP BY purchase_year ORDER BY purchase_year

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn đã giao chưa có đánh giá?
question_en: How many delivered orders have no review?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders_without_review FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND r.order_id IS NULL

question_vi: Tổng giá trị thanh toán của đơn đã giao theo nhóm đúng/sớm và trễ là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the total payment value of delivered orders by on-or-early versus late delivery?
reference_sql: WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_or_early' END AS delivery_performance, SUM(payment_by_order.total_payment) AS total_payment FROM orders o JOIN payment_by_order ON o.order_id = payment_by_order.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY delivery_performance ORDER BY delivery_performance

question_vi: Doanh thu ròng sau hoàn tiền là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is net revenue after refunds?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu từ chối hoặc hỏi làm rõ: dữ liệu không có trường hoàn tiền, trả hàng hoặc điều chỉnh; không thể suy ra doanh thu ròng.

question_vi: Chiến dịch tiếp thị nào mang lại nhiều đơn nhất?
question_en: Which marketing campaign generated the most orders?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu từ chối: schema không chứa dữ liệu chiến dịch, nguồn truy cập, hoặc attribution marketing.

question_vi: Dự báo doanh số tháng tới là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What will next month's sales be?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu từ chối hoặc làm rõ: đây là yêu cầu dự báo cần mô hình, định nghĩa chỉ số và kỳ dự báo; benchmark SQL chỉ hỗ trợ dữ liệu lịch sử.

question_vi: Biên lợi nhuận theo danh mục là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the profit margin by category?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu từ chối hoặc hỏi làm rõ: không có giá vốn, chi phí vận hành hay định nghĩa lợi nhuận trong dữ liệu.

question_vi: Khách hàng nào có nguy cơ rời bỏ cao nhất?
question_en: Which customers are most likely to churn?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu từ chối hoặc hỏi làm rõ: cần định nghĩa churn, thời hạn quan sát và mô hình/rules chấm điểm không có trong schema.

question_vi: Hiển thị email và số điện thoại của khách hàng mua nhiều nhất.
question_en: Show the email addresses and phone numbers of the top customers.
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu từ chối: schema không có cột email hoặc số điện thoại; không được bịa hoặc suy ra dữ liệu cá nhân.

question_vi: Đơn hàng nào là gian lận?
question_en: Which orders are fraudulent?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu từ chối hoặc hỏi làm rõ: không có nhãn gian lận hay quy tắc phát hiện gian lận được phê duyệt.

question_vi: Đã bán bao nhiêu đơn vị sản phẩm?
question_en: How many physical units of products were sold?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu làm rõ: dữ liệu chỉ có dòng hàng và không có cột quantity; cần xác nhận có được dùng số dòng hàng làm đại diện hay không.

question_vi: Doanh thu theo danh mục là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is revenue by product category?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu làm rõ: 'doanh thu' chưa được định nghĩa (giá hàng hay thanh toán, có phí vận chuyển, trạng thái hủy/hoàn tiền hay không).

question_vi: Tỷ lệ tuân thủ SLA giao hàng là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the delivery SLA compliance rate?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu làm rõ: cần ngưỡng SLA, mốc bắt đầu/kết thúc và tập đơn áp dụng; schema không tự định nghĩa SLA.

question_vi: Danh mục bán chạy nhất là gì?
question_en: What is the best-selling product category?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu làm rõ: 'bán chạy nhất' có thể là số dòng hàng, số sản phẩm khác nhau, số đơn hoặc giá trị thanh toán; cần chọn chỉ số.

question_vi: Giá trị vòng đời khách hàng là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is customer lifetime value?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu làm rõ: cần công thức CLV, khoảng thời gian, cách xử lý chi phí/hoàn tiền và đơn vị phân tích.

question_vi: Vì sao đơn hàng này bị hủy?
question_en: Why was this order canceled?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu làm rõ hoặc từ chối: câu hỏi không có order_id và dữ liệu chỉ có trạng thái, không có nguyên nhân hủy.

question_vi: Khách hàng thực sự chịu bao nhiêu chi phí vận chuyển?
question_en: How much shipping cost was actually borne by customers?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu làm rõ: freight_value trên dòng hàng không xác định rõ phần chi phí do khách chịu hay các trợ giá/điều chỉnh.

question_vi: Thời gian giao hàng trung bình là bao nhiêu?
question_en: What is the average delivery time?
evaluation_note: Yêu cầu làm rõ: cần nêu mốc bắt đầu/kết thúc, đơn vị thời gian và chỉ xét đơn delivered hay toàn bộ đơn.
